source_text: Another hadith, "Female circumcision is an act of Sunna for men and an honorable act for women," attributed to the Prophet but narrated through Al-Haggag ibn Artaa—a figure deemed a liar by hadith critics—has similarly been deemed inauthentic by authorities like Al-Bayhaqi and Ibn al-Barr. [23]
